description:
A state within a state machine.

States can declare entry/exit side effects as string references
and carry optional metadata for rendering hints.

description.description: Description of what this state means.

is_final.description: Whether this is a terminal state.

on_enter.description: Side effects triggered on entering this state (string references).

on_exit.description: Side effects triggered on exiting this state (string references).

title: StateDef
